prompt: I'm trying to work out how drip irrigation adds up. Let me change the flow in litres per minute and see how much water drains into a bucket in 6 minutes. No quiz, thanks.

content.text:
```openui lifecycle=ephemeral id=drip-irrigation-sim

root = LearningSurface([sim], "Drip Irrigation Calculator", "Adjust the flow rate to see how much water accumulates over 6 minutes.", "ephemeral")
sim = Simulation("drip-sim", "Drip Irrigation", 
  [{ id: "flow", label: "Flow Rate", unit: "L/min", min: 0.1, max: 5.0, step: 0.1, value: 0.5 }],
  [{ id: "total", label: "Total Water in 6 Minutes", unit: "Litres", expr: "flow * 6", emphasis: true }],
  "ephemeral",
  "Predict how much water will be in the bucket if you set the flow to 0.5 L/min. Then, adjust the slider to test your prediction."
)
```
